macros.name: eqcrefname
macros.doc: The \eqcrefname{⟨counter⟩}{⟨singular⟩}[⟨plural⟩] macro declares a cleveref name for an equation-like counter and formats label-only references to that counter in parentheses.

macros.name: subcref
macros.doc: If subcaption is loaded, the package additionally defines \subcref{⟨key⟩}, which applies \cref to the underlying subobject label.

macros.name: textlabel
macros.doc: The \textlabel[⟨reference format⟩]{⟨key⟩}[⟨text format⟩]{⟨text⟩} macro creates a hyperlink target and a label for a piece of text while also printing the text.

macros.name: usecommand
macros.doc: The \usecommand[⟨number of arguments⟩]{⟨definition⟩} helper defines a temporary command with the requested number of arguments and immediately applies it to the following arguments.
